a: अभिसां(शां)त्व् — {c10c} P. To conciliate, propitiate, pacify, comfort, console.
अभिसां(शां)त्वः, --त्वनं — Conciliation, consolation.

m: अभि-√ सान्त्व् (p. -सान्त्वयत्; ind.p. -सान्त्व्य) to conciliate, pacify, comfort, MBh. iv, 383; R. ii, 32, 39; MārkP.
अभि-सान्त्व m. consolation, conciliation, R. v, 56, 44.
अभि-सान्त्वित mfn. conciliated, pacified, Kām.
अभि-सारी f. N. of a town, MBh. ii, 1027.

m: अभि-सार &c. See अभि-√ सृ.
अभि-सार m. attack, assault, R.
meeting, rendezvous (of lovers), Sāh.; Gīt. &c.
‘pay for coming’, messenger's pay, Buddh.
companion, L.
a purificatory rite, L.
(एण) instr. (with सर्वेण) = सर्वाभिसारेण, q.v., MBh. iii, 639 (cf. लोहाभिसार and अभीसार)
N. of a people, MBh. &c.
a: अभिसारः — 1 Going to meet (as a lover), appointment, assignation; रतिसुखसारे गतमभिसारे मदनमनोहरवेशं Gīt. 5. --2 The place where lovers meet by appointment, rendezvous; त्वरितमुपैति न कथमभिसारं Gīt. 6. --3 An attack, assault; श्वोऽभिसारः पुरस्य नः Rām. --4 War, battle. --5 A follower, companion. --6 Might, power. --7 An instrument. --8 A purificatory rite. --9 (˚राः pl.) N. of a people. --री N. of a town. --Comp. --स्थानं a place fit for making appointments; see under अभिसारिका below.
अभिसारणं — Going to meet a lover &c.; Ki. 10. 58.

m: अभि-सार—स्थान n. a place of rendezvous (of lovers), Sāh.
अभि-सारिणी f. = अभि-सारिका, L.

N. of a species of the Triṣṭubh metre (as that in RV. x, 23, 5, in which two Pāda's contain twelve instead of eleven syllables, and which therefore is said to approach another metre called Jagatī), RPrāt.

v: strI aBisarati aBisArayati vA kAntaM saNketasTAna aBi + sf--Ric--bA Rvul । 1 “aBisArayate kAnta yA manmaTavaSaMvadA । svaya vABisaratyezA DIrEruktABi sArikA” sA॰ da॰ ukte nAyikABede “anaBijYAstamisrARAM durddinezvaBisArikAH” kumA॰ “yaH saYcaro'BUdaBisArikAsrAm” raGuH ।
m: अभि-सारिका f. a woman who goes to meet her lover or keeps an assignation, Kum. vi, 43; Ragh. xvi, 12, &c.
a: अभिसारिका — A woman who either goes to meet her lover or keeps an appointment made by him; Ku. 6. 43; R. 16. 12; अभिसारयते कांतं या मन्मथवशंवदा . स्वयं वाभिसरत्येषा धीरैरुक्ताऽभिसारिका S. D. 115; कांतार्थिनी तु या याति संकेतं साभिसारिका Ak. The directions as to dress &c. to be observed by the different kinds of अभिसारिका are given in S. D. 116. The S. D. further recommends the following {8} places as eligible spots for lovers to meet:-- (1) a field; (2) a garden; (3) a ruined temple; (4) the house of a female messenger; (5) forest; (6) caravansary (a place for pilgrims &c.); (7) a cemetery, and (8) the bank of a river; क्षेत्रं वाटी भग्नदेवालयो दूतीगृहं वनं . मालयं च श्मशानं च नद्यादीनां तटी तथा ..

k.v: कान्तार्थिनी तु या याति संकेतं साभिसारिका। पुंश्चली धर्षिणी बन्धक्यसती कुलटेत्वरी॥

v: tri॰ aBisarati Rini । 1 ABimuKyena gantari 2 anucare ca striyAM NIp । “zazWa trizwupe trEzwuBapadA dvO tu jAgatO yasyAH sA jAgate jagatI, trEzwuBe trizwup । vErAjO jAgatO cABisAriRI” anu॰ kra॰ ukte vEdikacCandoBede strI yamyAH vErAjO dvO pAdO dvO ca pAdO jAgatO sA'BisAriRIti tadarTaH ।
m: अभि-सारिन् mfn. going to meet, Vikr.
a: अभिसारिन् — a. Going to meet, visiting; attacking, rushing out, going forth; युद्धभिसारिणः U. 5. --णी 1 = अभिसारिका see above. --2 N. of a species of the त्रिष्टुभ् metre in which the Pādas contain 12 instead of 11 syllables, and which is therefore said to approach (अभिसरति) another metre called जगती.

m: अभि-सावकीय Nom. P. ˚यति, to long for a सावक (q.v.), Pāṇ. viii, 3, 65 Comm.
अभि-सावक &c. See अभि-षु.

a: अभिसायं — ind. At sunset, about evening; श्रितोदयाद्रेरभिसायमुच्चकैः Śi. 1. 16; Ki. 11. 51.

m: अभि-सायम् ind. about evening, at sunset, ChUp. (cf. अभि-प्रातर्.)
अभि-√ स्फूर्ज् -स्फूर्जति, to sound towards, AV. xii, 5, 20.
अभि-स्फुरित mfn. expanded to the full (as a blossom).
a: अभिस्फुरित — a. Expanded to the full, full-grown (as a blossom).

m: अभि-स्थिरम् ind. very firmly, intensely, ŚBr.
अभि-सू to bring forth, Bālar.
अभि-सूचित mfn. pointed out, MBh. iii, 2939.

1. अभि-सं-√ धा (3. du. -धत्तस्; Imper. 2. sg. -धेहि; aor. -अधात्) to snap at (acc.) for devouring, RV. x, 87, 3; AV.; ŚBr.; Kāṭh.; to take aim at (dat. or acc.), MBh. &c.; to aim at, have in view (with acc.; rarely dat.), ib.; to acknowledge unanimously, (perf. 3. pl. -दधुः), RV. i, 101, 6; to overcome, master, Mn. &c.; to win (as by presents), R. iv, 54, 5; to ally, associate with (instr.)
2. अभि-संधा f. ‘speech, declaration’ (only ifc. cf. अनृताभिसन्ध and सत्याभिसन्ध).
a: अभिसंधा — {c3c} U. 1 To hold together --2 To acknowledge, recognize; own. --3 To fit or fix a missile, arrow &c. to the bow. --4 To throw or shoot at, aim at; (शूलं) चिक्षेप परमक्रुद्धो लक्ष्मणायाभिसंहितं Rām. --5 To aim at, have in view, think of, (with acc.); पदाविद्धं यांती स्खलितमभिसंधाय बहुशः V. 4. 28 calling to mind, thinking of my fault; ऋष्यमूकमभिसंधाय Mv. 5 towards, in the direction of; Mv. 6; Bg. 17. 12, 25; sometimes with dat.; अभिसंदधते ये च विश्वासायास्य मानवाः Mb. --6 To deceive, cheat; जनं विद्वानेकः सकलमभिसंधाय Māl. 1. 14. --7 To come to an understanding or agreement; फलं त्वनभिसंधाय Ms. 9. 52 (एवं यत्र नियमो न कृतः). --8 To win over, make friendship with, ally oneself with; तान् सर्वानभिसंदध्यात्सामादिभिरुपक्रमैः Ms. 7. 159 (वशीकुर्यात्). --9 To declare solemnly, agree, promise. --10 To calumniate, traduce. --11 To add. --12 To prefer.
अभिसंधा — 1 Speech, declaration; word, assertion, promise; तेन सत्याभिसंधेन त्रिवर्गमनुतिष्ठता Rām. true to his word. --2 Deceit.

m: अभि-संधान n. the being allied or connected, connection between (in comp.), MBh. i, 3639
‘speech, deliberate declaration’ (only ifc. cf. सत्याभ्˚)
attachment or interest in any object
special agreement
overcoming, deceiving, Ragh. xvii, 76
making peace or alliance, L.
a: अभिसंधानं — 1 Speech, word, deliberate declaration, promise; सा हि सत्याभिसंधाना Rām. --2 Cheating, deception; पराभिसंधानपरं यद्यप्यस्य विचेष्टितं R. 17. 76. --3 Aim, intention, purpose; अन्याभिसंधानेनान्यवादित्वमन्यकर्तृत्वं च Mit. --4 Making peace. --5 Attachment or interest in any object.

m: अभि-संधाय ind.p. aiming at, having in view
coming to an agreement regarding (acc.), Mn. ix, 52
overcoming, Mālatīm. &c.
bringing in contact with (as an arrow with a bow), place upon (instr.), R. v, 36, 42.
a: अभिसंधायः — = अभिसंधि.
अभिसंधः, --धकः — 1 A deceiver, cheat. --2 Traducer, calumniator; Ms. 4. 195.

m: अभि-सं-√ धम् (1. sg. -धमामि) to blow at, AV. viii, 2, 4.

special agreement, Sāh.
cheating, deceiving
making peace or alliance, L.
joint, junction, L.
a: अभिसंधिः — 1 Speech; deliberate declaration, promise. --2 Intention, object, purpose, aim; तस्या अभिसंधिना विधेयीकृतोपि Māl. 1; Dk. 38; स्वर्ग˚ Ku. 6. 47. --3 Implied sense, the meaning intended, as in अयमभिसंधिः (frequently occurring in explanatory glosses). --4 Opinion, belief. --5 Special agreement, terms of an agreement, condition, stipulation; अथावश्यमेव माधवसेनः पूज्येन मोचयितव्यः श्रूयतामभिसंधिः M. 1. --6 Deception. --7 Making peace or alliance. --8 Junction, combination. --Comp. --कृत a. done intentionally.

m: अभि-संधि—कृत mfn. done intentionally.
अभि-संधि—पूर्व mfn. that which has been intended, aimed at, Gaut.

a: अभिसंख्य — a. Inferable, clearly ascertainable.

m: अभि-संख्येय mfn. to be enumerated, R.

a: अभिसंशीन — a. [श्यै-क्त] Coagulated, congealed.

m: अभि-संश्रय m. refuge, R.; connection, MBh. i, 2398.
a: अभिसंश्रयः — Refuge, shelter.

अभि-संश्रित mfn. who has resorted to any one (for refuge), MBh. xii, 2766
(for a visit), MBh.
अभि-सं-√ श्रु (ind.p. -श्रुत्य) to hear, learn, R.

अभिसंबंधः — Connection, relation; conjunction, contact; sexual connection; Ms. 5. 63.

अभि-सं-√ चिन्त् (ind.p. -चिन्त्य) to remember, MBh. vii, 5551.
अभि-संदष्ट (अभिसंदष्ट) mfn. (√ दंश्), compressed or tightened together, TS.

a: अभिसंदेहः — 1 Exchange. --2 Organ of generation (written also अभिसंदोह).
अभिसंदृष्ट — a. Compressed, tightened.

m: अभि-सं-√ 1. गॄ to promise, Kauś.
अभि-सं-√ गम् (ind.p. -गत्य, AV. xi, 1, 16, or -गम्य, R.; BhP.) to approach together, RV. ix, 14, 7 (aor. Ā. 3. pl. -अग्मत), &c.; to join in welcoming, BhP.; to meet with, R.
अभि-सं-गत mfn. together with (in comp.), BhP.
अभि-सं-√ ग्रह् to grasp at once with several fingers, Gobh.
अभि-संगुप्त mfn. guarded, protected, MBh. iii, 274.
अभि-सं-√ हन् (ind.p. -हत्य) to combine, confederate, MBh.
अभि-सं-हत mfn. attacked, assailed, BhP.
अभि-संहृत्य ind. conjointly, Mālatīm.

m: अभि-सं-हित See -सं-√ धा.

agreed upon, R. v, 82, 5
acknowledged by (in comp.), MBh. xii, 4793
overcome

अभि-सं-√ क्रुश् (ind.p. -क्रुश्य) to call out to, R.

(gen.), ib. iii, 682.

a: अभिसंमुख — a. Facing, fronting; looking respectfully towards.

a: अभिसंपातः — 1 Meeting together, concourse, confluence. --2 War, battle, contest. --3 A curse.

अभिसंपद् — {c4c} A. 1 To become (any thing); to be changed to, be similar to, assume the state of; इष्टकामग्निरभिसंपद्यते Śat. Br. श्रोत्रे हीमे सर्वे वेदा अभिसंपन्नाः ibid. --2 To come or go to, arrive at. --3 To get, obtain. --Caus. To make similar to, change into.
अभिसंपद् — f. Becoming complete; complete number.
अभिसंपन्न — p. p. Complete, completely effected; वदत्ययमभिसंपन्नमार्षेण संस्कारेण U. 5 quite in keeping with his holy instruction.
अभिसंपरायः — Futurity.

अभिसंपत्तिः — f. Becoming or being effected completely; going over, transition; being changed into.

अभि-संरम्भ m. fury, rage, MBh. xiv, 874.

a: अभिसंसारः — Coming together or in groups or flocks. --रं adv. Having approached together.

m: अभि-सं-सारम् ind. running near in crowds, ŚBr.
अभि-सं-√ स्था -तिष्ठते, to stop at, finish at (acc.), ŚāṅkhŚr. : Caus. to cause to stop or finish at (acc.), ChUp.
अभि-संस्थम् ind. in regular order, GopBr.
अभि-संस्थित mfn. stopping or standing or watching at some place, MBh.
reflecting upon (loc.), MBh. iv, 553.
अभि-सं-√ सृ (ind.p. -सृत्य) to run against or assail each other, BhP.
अभि-सं-सृत mfn. one who has come near, MBh. viii, 4417.
अभि-संस्कार m. ‘the being formed’, development (as of seeds), Car.
preparation, ib.
conception, idea, Buddh.
a: अभिसंस्कारः — 1 Idea, thought, imagination. --2 Vain or profitless performance.

m: अभि-सं-स्-√ 1. कृ -स्-करोति, to shape, form, ŚBr. : Ā. (Subj. 1. sg. -स्-करवै) to render or make one's self (आत्मानम्) anything (wished to be acc.), ŚBr.
a: अभिसंस्कृ — {c8c} U. 1 To shape, form, build. --2 To make, render. --3 To consecrate.

m: अभि-संस्कृत mfn. consecrated, MBh.
अभि-सं-√ स्मृ to recollect (with acc.), MBh. iii, 15758.
अभि-सं-√ स्पृश् to wash one's self, MBh. iii, 8080; to seize, ib. xii, 2140.
अभि-सं-√ स्रु to unite in flowing into (acc.), ŚBr.
अभि-सं-स्तीर्ण mfn. (√ स्तॄ), entirely covered with, MBh. xii, 7613.
अभि-सं-√ स्तम्भ् (ind.p. -स्तभ्य) to support, render firm, Kauś.; R.
अभि-संस्तव m. praise, L.
a: अभिसंस्तवः — High praise.

m: अभि-सं-√ स्तु (pr. p. -स्तुवत्) to praise highly, MBh. xiii, 3695.
अभि-संस्तुत mfn. highly praised, MBh.; BhP.
अभि-सं-√ 3. सु (3. du. -सं-सुनुतस्) to press out (Soma juice) together for the sake of (acc.), TBr.
अभि-सं-√ स्वञ्ज् Ā. (Imper. 2. sg. -स्वजस्व) to embrace, AV. xii, 3, 12.
अभि-सं-√ स्वृ (impf. 3. pl. -अस्वरन् [four times] or -अस्वरन् [once]) to praise or call or invite unanimously, RV.

a: अभिसंतापः — War, battle, contest; जन्यं स्यादभिसंतापः Halāy.

m: अभि-सं-√ तॄ to cross over towards (acc.), AitBr.
अभि-सं-√ तन् (3. pl. -तन्वन्ति) to use for bridging over or stretching across, TBr.; PBr.
अभि-सं-√ तप् (Subj. -तपाति) to press hard on all sides, AV. ii, 12, 6.
a: अभिसंतप् — {c1c} P. To torment, = संतप् q. v.

m: अभि-संतप्त mfn. tormented, MBh. &c.
अभि-संतत mfn. spread over, covered with (in comp.), Hariv. (v.l. अभि-सं-वृत).
अभि-संत्रस्त mfn. (√ त्रस्), terrified, much alarmed, R.
अभि-सं-√ त्यज् (ind.p. -त्यज्य) to abandon, give up, desist from (acc.), MBh.
अभि-सं-√ वाञ्छ् to long for, KenaUp.
अभि-सं-वीक्ष् (√ ईक्ष्) to look at in astonishment, gaze at, Kād.
1. अभि-सं-√ 4. वस् Ā. (pr. p. 1. -वसान) to wrap one's self into (acc.), AV. xii, 3, 52.
2. अभि-सं-√ 5. वस् Ā. (pr. p. 2. -वसान) to settle round (acc.) together, TBr.; Lāṭy.
अभि-सं-√ 1. वृ (impf. -वृणोत्) to cover, conceal, MBh. v, 7239.
अभि-संवृद्ध mfn. (said of a tree) ‘having grown a very long time’, very old, MBh. xii, 5805.
अभि-सं-√ वृत् Ā. (Imper. -वर्तताम्) to turn one's self towards, AV. vi, 102, 1.
अभि-संवृत mfn. covered, concealed, MBh. &c.
surrounded by, accompanied by, ib.
filled with, furnished with, ib.
a: अभिसंवृत — a. Clothed, clad.

m: अभि-संवृत्त mfn. undertaking, beginning to (Inf.), R.

v: strI aBi + sam + vfta--ktin । 1 vyavahAre 2 aBinizpanne ca

m: अभि-सं-√ विश् P. Ā. (Imper. 2. pl. -सं-विशध्वम्) to meet round or near, surround, AV. &c.; to enter into, dissolve in TUp.; NṛsUp.
1. अभि-सं-√ 1. विद् (perf. 3. pl. -विदुस्) to know thoroughly, AV. iii, 21, 5.
2. अभि-सं-√ 3. विद् Ā. (pr. p. -विदान) to meet each other [BR.], VS. xxix, 6 (‘to relate, explain’ Comm.)
अभि-सं-√ या -याति, to visit, approach to (acc.), RV. ix, 86, 15; Kāṭh.; to approach in hostile manner, assail, MBh. viii, 1826.
अभि-सं-√ यम् to hold against, Gobh.
अभि-सं-यत्त mfn. (√ यत्), being taken care of or governed by (v.l. अभि-सम्पन्न), MBh. vii, 5173.
अभि-संयोग m. (in Mīmāṃsā phil.) close contact or relation to.
a: अभिसंयोगः — Close {{contat->contact||20210104|Dr. Sampada Savardekar and Jim Funderburk|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/20|}} or union, intimate connection.

m: अभि-सं-√ युज् Caus. to bring in close contact with (instr.), Hariv.
अभि-संयुक्त mfn. furnished or endowed with, R.
अभि-√ सच् See अभि-षच्.
अभि-सम्-आ-√ गम् to approach together, Nir.; to come to (acc.), MBh. xi, 445.
अभि-सम्-आ-√ हृ to scrape up or together, Kauś.
अभि-सम्-आ-हित mfn. (√ धा), fastened to, connected with (instr.), R.
अभि-सम्-आ-√ पद् Ā. (perf. -पेदे) to enter upon (acc.), R. ii, 12, 1.
अभि-सम्-आ-√ रुह् (impf. 3. pl. -अरोहन्) to enter upon (the sacrificial fireplace) for a purpose (acc.), TBr.
अभि-सम्-आ-√ सिच् to pour together, Kauś.
अभि-सम्-आ-√ वृत् Ved. (3. pl. -आवर्तन्ते and impf. -आवर्तन्त; fut. p. -वर्त्स्यमान) to return home, TBr. &c.
अभि-सम्-आ-√ या to approach together, MBh. v, 1974.
अभि-सम्-आ-√ यम् -यच्छति, to fasten to (acc.), TBr.
अभि-सम्-आ-युक्त mfn. connected or endowed with (instr.), MBh. xii, 3478.
अभि-सम्-√ भू Ved. (perf. 2. sg. -बभूथ) to reach, come to, arrive at, RV. x, 18, 8, &c.; to obtain the shape of (acc.), be changed into, ŚBr. : Caus. to salute, BhP.
अभि-सम्-भग्न mfn. broken, crashed, MBh. viii, 2801.
अभि-सम्भव, m., अभि-सम्भवन, n. attainment, Śaṃk.
अभि-सम्-भृत mfn. endowed with (in comp.), MBh. xii, 12959 (v.l. अभि-सं-वृत).
अभि-सम्-ईक्ष्य ind.p. (√ ईक्ष्), seeing, viewing, R.
noticing, perceiving, learning from, RPrāt.; Suśr.
considering, with reference to, Suśr.; Car.
अभि-सम्-√ ईर् Caus. (perf. Pass. p. -ईरित) to put in motion, MBh. x, 579.
अभि-सम्-√ 1. ऊह् -ऊहति, to heap up, PBr.; to heap up and cover with (as with ashes instr.), TS.; ŚBr.
अभि-सम्-√ 2. अस् to put together, group, collect, Car.
अभि-समवाय m. (√ इ), union, association, L.
a: अभिसमवायः — Union.

m: अभि-समय See अभि-सम्-√ इ.
अभि-समय m. agreement, Car.
clear understanding, Buddh.
अभि-सम्बाध mfn. pressed together, crowded, R.
अभि-सम्बद्ध mfn. connected, (अन्- neg.), Suśr.

अभि-सम्-√ बन्ध् -बध्नाति, to refer to (acc.), mean by Comm. on BṛĀrUp. : Pass. -बध्यते, ‘to be referred to’, belong to, require to be connected with (instr. [Pat.] or acc. [Pāṇ. ii, 1, 6 and 2, 11, Sch. &c.]).

v: pu॰ aBi + sam + banDa--GaY । 1 aBitaH sambanDe “dravyARAM karmmasaMyoge guRAtvanABisambanDaH” “PalArTitvA tu svAmitve nABi” jE॰ sU॰ “vEjikAdaBisambanDAdanarunDyAdaGaM tryaham” manuH 2 vAkyAdO AkANkzitapadAnvaye ca padAnAmanvayaSca padArTAyanvayogyatvaeva ।
m: अभि-सम्बन्ध m. connection with, relation to (instr.), Jaim.
being connected with, belonging to, Sāh.; Pāṇ., Sch.
sexual connection, MBh. xiii, 2924; Mn. v, 63.
अभि-सम्-बोधन n. attaining the Bodhi, Buddh.
अभि-सम्-√ बुध् (with सम्यक्-सम्बोधिन्), to obtain the highest perfect knowledge, Sukh. i.
अभि-सम्-बुद्ध mfn. deeply versed in MBh. iii, 12515
having attained the Bodhi, Buddh.
अभि-सम्-ए (-आ-√ इ), Ved. (Imper. अभि … सम्-ऐतु [AV. vi, 102, 1] or आ … अभि सम्-एतु [RV. vi, 19, 9]) to join in coming near (acc.), approach together.
अभि-सम्-एत mfn. assembled, ŚBr. xiv.
अभि-सम्-√ ऋ Ā. (aor. Opt. -अरीत) to reach, seize, RV. ix, 79, 3.
अभि-सम्-√ इ -एति (3. pl. -यन्ति, Imper. -यन्तु), Ved. to approach together, come together or meet at (acc.), RV. i, 125, 7; AV. &c.; (Opt. 3. pl. -ईयुः) to invade, TS.
अभि-सम्-√ इन्ध् to set on fire, kindle, PBr.
अभि-सम्-मूढ mfn. entirely confused, MBh. iii, 12219.
अभि-सम्-√ मूर्छ् (p. -मूर्छत्) to assume a solid form with regard to or in connection with (acc.), ŚBr.
अभि-सम्-मत mfn. honoured, esteemed, MārkP. &c.
अभि-सम्-मुख mf(आ)n. looking respectfully towards (acc.), ŚBr.

v: pu॰ aBi + sam + pata--ADAre GaY । 1 yudDe । BAve GaY । 2 patane । karaRe GaY । 3 aBiSApe lokaprasidDiH ।
m: अभि-सम्पात m. concourse, war, battle, L.

k.v: सम्प्रहाराभिसम्पात कलिसंस्फोट संयुगाः। अभ्यामर्द समाघात संग्रामाभ्यागमाहवाः॥

m: अभि-सम्-√ पू -पवते, to blow along over or towards (acc.), TBr.
अभि-सम्-√ पूज् (generally ind.p. -पूज्य) to honour, revere greatly, MBh.; MārkP.
अभि-सम्-√ पच् Pass. (3. pl. -पच्यन्ते) to become ripe up to a certain time (acc.), PBr.

m: 1. अभि-सम्-√ पद् Ved. -पद्यते, to become; to become similar to, be changed to (acc.), ŚBr. &c.; to come to, arrive at, obtain, ŚBr. xiv; Up. : Caus. -पादयति, to make equal to, change into (acc.), ŚBr.; AitBr.
2. अभि-सम्पद् f. id., ŚBr.
अभि-सम्पन्न mfn. becoming similar to, being changed to (acc.), ŚBr.; RPrāt.
being in accordance with, agreeing with (instr.), Uttarar.
अभि-सम्पराय m. (√ इ), futurity, Lalit.
अभि-सम्-√ पत् (p. -पतत्; perf. 3. pl. -पेतुः) to fly to, hasten to (acc.), MBh. vii, 7295, &c.

v: tri॰ aBi + sam + pada--ktin । 1 aBitaH sampattO anyarUpasyAnyaTABavane, “cityasyAhavanIyABisampatteH” kAtyA॰ 18, 6, 35 । “AhavanIya eva cityABisampatti SravaRAt “yo vAva cito'gnirniGoyate tAmevezwakAmeza sarvo'gniraBisampadyata” itiSrutiH ekavAraM cityasyopari niDAnenAhavanIyAgnereva sarvvadA cityAtmakatAsampannA” karka॰ ।
m: अभि-सम्पत्ति f. becoming anything, becoming similar or equal to, KātyŚr.
अभि-सम्प्लव m. fluctuation, Bcar.
अभि-सम्-√ प्लु (ind.p. -प्लुत्य) to bathe, MBh. xii, 365 (अन्- neg.)
अभि-सम्-प्लुत mfn. poured upon, overflowed with, MBh. ix, 3279
deeply engaged in (in comp.), R.
अभि-सम्-प्राप् (√ आप्) to reach, come to, arrive at, obtain, L.
अभि-सम्-प्र-हा (only ind.p. -हाय), to forsake, Divyāv.
अभि-सम्-प्र-√ पद् -पद्यते (= अभि-सम्-√ पद्) to be changed to, assume or obtain the shape of (acc.), Up.
अभि-सम्-प्र-√ वृत् Caus. to change (?as a battle-field, रणाजिरम्), MBh. i, 1184.
अभि-सम्-प्रवृत्त mfn. having begun, VarBṛS.
अभि-सम्-प्र-√ या (ind.p. -याय) to go towards, MBh. vi, 3762 (v.l. अभि-वारयित्वा)
अभि-सम्-प्रेक्ष् (√ ईक्ष्), (ind.p. -प्रेक्ष्य) to look at, perceive, MBh.; R.
अभि-सम्-√ उब्ज् to spread a covering upon (acc.), PBr.

v: na॰ aBi + sam + DA--lyuw । 1 paravaYcane । “parABisanDAnaparaM yadyapyasya vicezwitam” raGuH । “parABimanDAnaparAmantriRaH” kAda॰ 2 PaloddeSe 3 aBisanDO ca । “PalABisanDAnaparA na yoginaH” purA॰ ।
pu॰ aBi + sam + DA--BAve GaY । 1 aBisanDO PalAdyuduSe । lyap । 3 PalAdyuddiSyetyarTe avya॰ । “aBisanDAya tu Pala damBArTamapi cEva yat” gItA ।
tri॰ aBi + sam + DA--ka--svArTe kan । 1 paraguRAsahanena Akzepake, “vEqAlavrAtakojYeyohiMsraH sarvABisanDakaH manuH” । “aBisanDakaH paraguRAsahanena sarvAkzepaka iti” kUllU॰ ।
m: अभि-सन्धक mfn. ifc. deceiving [‘calumniating’ Comm.] Mn. iv, 195.

v: pu॰ aBi + sam + vA--BAve ki । 1 PalAdyudeSe । “svargABisanDi makftaM vaYcanAmiva menire” kumA॰ । “svaDABujaH kAmyaPalABisanDO” rucistavaH ।
tri॰ aBisanDA jAtA'sya tAra॰ itav । 1 jAtABisanDO aBisanDivizaye ।

v: pu॰ aBisantApyate'nena aBi + sam + tapa--RickaraRe ac । 1 aBiSApe । tapa--BAve GaY । 2 aBitaH santApe । tapa--ADAre । GaY । 3 yudDe ।

m: अभि-√ सप् (3. pl. Ā. -सपन्ते) to carry on, manage, RV. vii, 38, 5.

s: puM, (ABimuKyena sarati, aBi + sf + pacAdyac .) sahAyaH । anucaraH । ityamaraH ॥ (“rAjA rAjyavardDanaM mahAsAmantEH kftvA sABisaram uttarApaTaM prAhiRot” । iti harzacarite .)
v: tri॰ aBitaHsarati sf + wa striyAM NIp । 1 sahAye 2 anucare । “taTEvABisarAstezAM tyaktAtmAno jaye DftAH” BA॰ u॰ pa॰ । “aTa sABisaraM SarEstarasvI” mAGaH ।
m: अभि-सर &c. See अभि-√ सृ.
अभि-सर m. (ifc. f(आ). ) a companion, Daś.
a: अभिसर, --सर्ग, --सर्जन — &c. see under अभिसृ, अभिसृज् &c.
अभिसरः — 1 A follower, an attendant; Dk. 73, 127. --2 A companion; मन्मथाभिसरा तदागारमभिसरामि Dk. 15. --3 N. of a people.

v: na॰ aBi + sf--lyuw । 1 aBigamane 2 nAyakayorekatareRa rAgeRa saNketasTAnagamane ca ।
m: अभि-सरण n. meeting, rendezvous (of lovers), Sāh. &c.
a: अभिसरणं — 1 Approaching, going to meet (also with hostile intentions). --2 Meeting, rendezvous, assignation or appointment of lovers; त्वदभिसरणरभसेन वलंती पतति पदानि कियंति चलंती Gīt. 6.

m: अभि-सर्ग &c. See अभि-√ सृज्.
अभि-सर्ग m. creation, MBh. xii, 13801.
a: अभिसर्गः — Creation.

m: अभि-सर्जन n. for अति-स्˚ (q.v.), L.
a: अभिसर्जनं — 1 A gift, donation. --2 Killing.

s: klI, (aBi + sfj + BAve lyuw .) dAnaM । baDaH । iti DaraRI ॥
v: na॰ aBi + sfja--BAve GaY । 1 dAne 2 baDe 3 utsfzwe ca

m: अभि-सर्पण See अभि-√ सृप्.
अभि-सर्पण n. approaching
the ascent (of sap in the trees).
a: अभिसर्पणं — Approaching, drawing near (with hostile intention).

m: अभि-सर्तृ mfn. attacking, assailant, VS. xxx, 14.
a: अभिसर्तृ — a. One who attacks; an assistant.

m: अभि-सत्कृ (√ 1. कृ), (ind.p. -कृत्य) to honour, receive (a guest) with reverence, MBh. ii, 2549.
अभि-सत्कृत m. n. honoured, received with reverence, MBh. &c.
अभि-सत्वन् m. surrounded by heroes, RV. x, 103, 5 (cf. अभि-वीर.)
a: अभिसत्वन् — a. Ved. Surrounded by heroes; (cf. अभिवीर).

m: अभि-सेवन n. practising, cultivating, Suśr.
a: अभिसेवनं — 1 Practising, observing. --2 Cultivating. --3 Fondness of, indulgence in.

m: अभि-√ सृ (3. pl. impf. -असरन्, perf. -सस्रुर्) to flow towards (acc.), RV. i, 52, 5 and ix, 82, 3; to approach, go towards, advance in order to meet, attack, MBh. &c.; to go to a rendezvous (said of lovers), Sāh. : Caus. to lead towards, Kathās.; to cause to attack, lead to battle, MBh. iii, 665 (v.l.); to invite to a rendezvous, Sāh.; to approach, visit, MBh. i, 1221; Mṛcch.
a: अभिसृ — {c1c} P. 1 To go up to, go towards, approach; to go to some place or other, go or proceed; पुरोभिसस्रे सुरसुंदरीजनैः Ki. 8. 4. --2 To attack, assail. --3 To go or advance to meet (as at an appointed place); सुंदरीरभिससार K. 58; Dk. 51, 52, 91; Śi. 6. 26. --Caus. To visit, approach, go to meet; वल्लभानभिसिसारयिषूणां 10. 20, 21; S. D. 115; Ki. 9. 38; Mk. 8.

m: अभि-√ सृज् (impf. -असृजत्; aor. Pass. -असर्जि [RV. ix, 106, 12] and 3. pl. -असृग्रन् [RV. ix, 88, 6] or -असृक्षत [RV. i, 135, 6 and ix, 63, 25]) to pour into or upon (acc.), pour out for a purpose (acc.) or for the sake of (acc.), RV.; AV.; AitBr.; to let loose in a special direction, ŚBr.; AitBr.; (aor. Subj. 2. sg. -स्रास् for -स्राक्ष्-स्) to throw upon, AV. xi, 2, 19; to surrender, give, grant, allow, permit, R. &c.; to assail, attack, ŚBr. xiv.
a: अभिसृज् — {c6c} P. 1 To pour out or forth; Rv. 1. 135. 6. --2 To make, prepare; तस्य चितेयमभिसृष्टा Mv. 5. --3 To unloose, untie. --4 To give, grant; अभिसृज्य वरद्वयं Rām. --5 To fall upon, attack.

m: अभि-सृप् (Imper. 2. sg. -सर्प) to approach silently or softly, AV.; Kāṭh.; Nir.
अभि-सृत mfn. gone near (acc.), MBh. vii, 4449; Gīt.
one who has approached (for attacking), MBh.
directed towards (in comp.), VarBṛS.
visited by (instr.), Kathās.
अभि-सृत्य ind.p. having gone near (acc.)

v: pu॰ aBi + sfja--kta । 1 datte, 2 utsfzwe, 3 tyakte ca
m: अभि-सृष्ट mfn. ‘let loose in a special direction’, running towards (acc. or loc.), RV.
allowed to, R.
uttered, Hariv.
surrendered, given, granted, R. &c.
1. अभि-√ 1. सिध् -सेधति, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 113, Sch.
2. अभि-√ 3. सिध् -सिध्यति, to be accomplished, MBh. xii, 7427; to obtain, win (with acc.), ChUp.
अभि-सिद्धि f. the state of being effected or realized, AgP.
अभि-सिसारयिषु mfn. intending to go to a rendezvous or to visit (a lover), Śiś. x, 20.

a: अभिस्कंदः — Ved. 1 An attack, assault. --2 An assailant, enemy. --दं adv. By attacking.

m: अभि-√ स्कम्भ् Caus. (p. -स्कभायत्), Pāṇ. iii, 1, 84 Comm.
अभि-√ स्कन्द् (perf. -चस्कन्द) to ascend, AV. vii, 115, 2.
अभि-स्कन्द accord. to some, ‘m. the mounting [buck]’, AV. v, 14, 11.
अभि-स्कन्दम् ind. running near, AV. v, 14, 11.
अभि-√ स्मि (p. -स्मयत्) to smile upon, MBh. iii, 8732.
अभि-स्नेह m. affection, desire, BhP.
a: अभिस्नेहः — Attachment, affection; love, desire; यः सर्वत्रानभिस्नेहः Bg. 2. 57.

m: अभि-स्निग्ध See अन्-अभिस्न्˚.
अभि-√ स्पृश् (Opt. -स्पृशेत्) to touch, MBh. i, 2931; to influence, affect, Suśr.
अभि-√ स्रंस् aor. Subj. 2. sg. -स्रास्, which is better derived fr. अभि-√ स्रिज्, q.v.
अभि-√ स्रु (Imper. 3. pl. -स्रवन्तु) to cause to flow near, RV. x, 9, 4; (p. -स्रवन्त for -स्रवत्), MBh. xiii, 901.
अभि-स्तरण n. scattering, strewing, TBr., Sch.
अभि-√ स्तृ to scatter over, cover, TBr.; Suśr.
अभि-सुसूष् mfn. desirous of expressing Soma Juice, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 117, Sch.
अभि-सुसूष् See अभि-षु.

v: na॰ svf--BAve--vic svaH aBitaH svaH svaraRaM Sabdo bA yasya । aBitaH svarayuktestotraBede “aBisvarA nizadA gA avasyavaH” f॰ 2, 21, 5 aBitaH svaH svaraH SabdanaM vA yasya tena stotreRa” BA॰ । “stotraM nemiM namanti cakzasA mezaM viprA aBisvarA” f॰ 8, 97, 12 “aBisvarA aBisvaraRena stotreRa” BA॰ ।
m: अभि-स्वर् f. (instr. -स्वरा) invocation, RV. ii, 21, 5 and viii, 97, 12
a: अभिस्वर् — f. (or n. according to some) [अभितः स्वः स्वरणशब्दो यस्य] Ved. 1 Invocation, calling into one's presence. --2 A song or hymn of praise.

v: pu॰ aBi + svf--ap । ABimuKyena preraRe “sTAtaraTasya haryoraBiraBisvare” SrutiH ।
a: अभिस्वरः — Urging towards, driving onwards. --रे Very close or near.

m: अभि-स्वरे ind. dat. ‘for calling into one's presence’, just behind (with gen.), RV. iii, 45, 2 and x, 117, 8; VS.
अभि-स्वर्तृ ता, m. an invoker, RV. x, 78, 4.
a: अभिस्वर्तृ — m. Praising; invoking.

m: अभि-स्वयमातृण्णम् ind. on the brick (used in sacrifices and called) स्वयमातृण्णा (q.v.), ŚBr.
अभि-√ स्वृ (Imper. 2. sg. -स्वर, 3. pl. -स्वरन्तु) to join in praising or invoking, RV.; to keep a note (in singing) up to (acc.), PBr.
a: अभिस्वृ — {c1c} P. 1 To assent or agree to, approve of. --2 To praise, invoke.

m: अभि-√ स्यन्द् See अभि-ष्यन्द्.
